features: Thermal & Optical dual-spectrum image, dual video with single IP address, adaptable to various scenes
Thermal channel supports fire detection, and the optical channel can link to the fire position and zoom in for more accurate fire situation judgment
Optical channel supports 4 MP@60 fps, providing smoother motion images
Optical channel supports gyroscope stabilization for stable pictures
Optical channel supports heat wave reduction, which can reduce heat wave phenomena and improve image quality
Vari-focal laser: 800 m (2624.7 ft) distance, proportional to optical zoom of camera module

frigate.notes: Uniview IPC — ONVIF + Uniview /unicast RTSP path. Use the sub stream (s1) for Frigate detection.

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.
